manus: GTA 6 made 3.79 billion dollars on day one. That's Take-Two's official number. Before launch, it had already sold 32.5 million copies. And analysts at Alinea estimate almost 45 million copies in the first four days. About 34 million on PS5, and 11 million on Xbox. Rockstar hasn't confirmed that estimate yet. For comparison, GTA 5 made about one billion dollars in its first three days. Follow for more GTA 6 news.
